note: Endpoints drift. Re-verify against each vendor's own documentation before trusting this file. Writing a .mcp.json entry does not finish setup for an OAuth connector: run /mcp once inside Claude Code to authorize it.

connectors.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions runs.
connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_PAT"
connectors.notes: Anthropic also ships an official plugin. Prefer `claude plugin install github@claude-plugins-official` when you install through the marketplace. A GitHub Enterprise Server tenant uses its own host, not this URL.

connectors.description: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket and Compass.
connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp
connectors.notes: The HTTP+SSE endpoint /v1/sse was deprecated with a 30 June 2026 sunset. Use /v2/mcp. Atlassian Cloud only. Complete the OAuth login with /mcp.

connectors.description: Read a design's structure, variables and code context from a Figma file.
connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp
connectors.notes: Anthropic ships an official plugin: prefer `claude plugin install figma@claude-plugins-official`. A desktop alternative runs from the Figma app with Dev Mode enabled, on a local port; take that URL from the app rather than assuming one.

connectors.description: Drive a real browser to test a running application.
connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project playwright npx @playwright/mcp@latest
connectors.notes: Runs locally and needs no credential. It downloads a browser on first use, so the first call is slow.

connectors.description: Search, read and create Lucidchart and Lucidspark documents.
connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http lucid https://mcp.lucid.app/mcp
connectors.notes: A Lucid account admin must enable MCP access in the Admin Panel before any user can connect. Without that, the OAuth login fails and the reason is not obvious.

connectors.description: Rally stories, defects, iterations and test cases.
connectors.server: Broadcom Rally MCP (AI Coding Assistance Integration)

userInput.prompt: Env var holding the Rally credential

connectors.addExample: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http rally <YOUR_RALLY_MCP_URL> --header "Authorization: Bearer $RALLY_API_KEY"
connectors.notes: Rally MCP is tenant-hosted. There is no single public endpoint, so this catalog carries no default URL. A Rally admin provisions the host and the credential. Ask your platform team for both.
